title: Return, return, Clan Milly
html_source: Reference to “Clan Milly” is to the Milesians (See adjacent annotation). the entreaty to “Return, return,” is both for the Irish to “forget me not,” the “me” being, potentially, both Joyce (to whom the directive to return applies), or the “Me,” the God of Saint Patrick. Or the “me” could also be the prototypical, if only in the ideal, Irishman.
